_about: Forge services (Godot build: game/systems/forge.gd), at any npc with `forge: true` (a smith in any major town). Raising gear's item level and scrapping gear are enchanters' work (enchanting.json). `reforge` swaps one of an item's stats for another, from `options` choices shown up front, for coins (one reforge an item; doing it again replaces it). `sockets`: a socket takes `share` of the item's stat budget, which a gem of its quality fills back (gems.json); a forge can punch one more (`punch`) into enhanced gear or better, to `max` sockets.
